attack_path_facts.title: Persisted manifest unit_ref can escape its normalized-instance directory
attack_steps: A lower-trust contributor supplies an adopted store containing a normalized manifest whose Done entry has an absolute or parent-traversing unit_ref.

load_normalized_units at crates/kcs-cli/src/main.rs:3367-3389 appends .json, joins the unvalidated reference, and reads the resulting external path; load_previous_instance repeats the sink at lines 9691-9713.
If the bytes parse as NormalizedUnitObject, their markdown can be chunked and indexed at crates/kcs-cli/src/main.rs:3030-3127 or reused as previous context under the current scope.
assumptions: The victim adopts copied, shared, synced, or preseeded normalized state.
The contributor knows or can arrange a victim-readable external normalized-unit JSON path.
The selected bytes parse as a compatible NormalizedUnitObject and a rebuild/index/incremental workflow runs.
attack_path_facts.context: Lower-trust persisted metadata directs the victim process outside the normalized-instance boundary and imports another scope's normalized data using the victim's filesystem authority.
attack_path_facts.in_scope: yes; archive adoption, path confinement, and normalized provenance are covered by I1 and I7
attack_path_facts.exposure: not public; deterministic local reachability through ordinary processing of an adopted store
attack_path_facts.identity: KCS reads as the victim OS user. The supplied-store contributor controls unit_ref without requiring arbitrary write access to the victim's private live store.
attack_path_facts.cross_boundary: yes: a manifest entry escapes its instance and imports a victim-readable external normalized unit into current-scope derived state

mitigations: Normal writers derive canonical 16-lowercase-hex unit references.

Search liveness joins chunks to current tree/profile/generation tuples.
OS permissions limit readable external units.
attack_path_facts.impact_surface: cross-scope data confidentiality, normalized provenance, chunks, search/evidence integrity, and incremental context

counterevidence: Fresh stores are intended owner-only, so ordinary direct-child contributors cannot normally edit a healthy live manifest.
